projects.title: Saarthi - Travel Unfolded
projects.description: An open travel guide to India and the source-tracked dataset behind it: 2,484 destinations and 411,630 mapped places merged from Wikidata, OpenStreetMap, Overture Maps and Wikivoyage. Every detail links to its source, and locals can confirm or correct it.

projects.title: Finora - Personal Finance Tracker
projects.description: Local-first finance app for Android and iOS with no account, server or database. Tracks investments with exact XIRR, SIPs, loans and capital-gains tax, imports CAMS and CDSL statements on the device, and keeps everything in an encrypted vault. 79 unit tests.

projects.title: AI Engineering Patterns
projects.description: Open-source reference for production LLM and agentic systems: 37 named patterns across inference, caching, routing, RAG, evaluation, security and orchestration, each with a runnable Python implementation. 200 passing tests.

projects.title: Evidelta - Provider Change Intelligence
projects.description: Answers 'is it us or the provider?' for teams on AI APIs. Collects public signals, grades changes with a deterministic rubric, and rejects any synthesized claim that is uncited or stronger than its evidence allows.

projects.title: Minerva - Modern Chess Engine
projects.description: UCI-compliant chess engine in C++20 with bitboards, alpha-beta search, transposition tables and hybrid classical/NNUE evaluation, plus a PyTorch pipeline for training, quantizing and cross-verifying NNUE models.

projects.title: Calibrate - GPU Training Efficiency Analyzer
projects.description: Rust CLI that attaches to a running training job and reports Model FLOP Utilization, where compute is being lost, p50/p99 inference latency across runtimes, and fine-tuning cost against live GPU pricing.

projects.title: Aegis InfraGuard - Cloud Infrastructure CLI
projects.description: Analyzes Terraform configurations: AWS cost estimates across 30+ resource variants, Rego policy enforcement, statistical anomaly detection on runtime metrics, and automated rightsizing recommendations.

projects.title: Lumen - Document Processing System
projects.description: Turns uploaded PDFs and images of medical reports into plain-English explanations through OCR, entity parsing and LLM extraction, with async Redis-backed jobs, cache-first results and live progress.

projects.title: FitAI - Local-First AI Fitness Coach
projects.description: Installable PWA where all data stays in the browser's IndexedDB and AI calls go straight from the client to the user's chosen provider (Groq, OpenAI or local Ollama). No server and no account.

projects.title: Performance - Running & Workout Tracker
projects.description: Fitness tracker for running and workouts with weekly history, streaks, goals and consistency analytics, including timezone-aware activity handling and historical goal configurations. Used by friends and colleagues.

projects.title: AutoSQL - Self-Optimizing Query Pipeline
projects.description: Single-file tool that has an LLM rewrite a slow SQL query, rejects any rewrite whose results differ, measures the speedup and feeds the history back. Its README example reaches 6.3x faster.

projects.title: QuantScope - AI Market Analysis
projects.description: Streamlit app for global market analysis with live data, technical indicators, interactive charts and LLM-generated insights built on LangChain.

projects.title: Behind the Trade - Market Settlement Explainer
projects.description: Interactive site that shows what happens after you click Buy: a price-time-priority order book, live matching over WebSockets, and the T+2 clearing and settlement cycle.
